name: centrosomal protein 63

function.text: CEP63 is the approved symbol for centrosomal protein 63. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in molecular adaptor activity; centriole replication; centrosome duplication.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Seckel syndrome 6 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.
